sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.description:
Retrieves relevant Knowledge articles for the current Food Base Problem.
The search must be based on the actual Food Base Problem context, especially: - Use Case - Problem Type - Meal Type - Mess Hall - Description
Only use Knowledge articles that are relevant to the current problem.
For an Allergy Management Request, prioritize allergy and allergen-management guidance.
Do not use Knowledge articles to determine Priority.
sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.inputs: [{"name":"search_type","description":"Search type","value":"hybrid"},{"name":"query","description":"search query for retrieving relevant information from Knowledge Table"},{"name":"search_profile","value":"sn_aia_ai_agents_agent_search","label":"[AI Agents] - Agent Search","description":"Search profile"},{"name":"sources","label":["Knowledge Table"],"value":["kb_knowledge"],"description":"Search sources"},{"name":"fields","label":["Number [kb_knowledge]","Short description [kb_knowledge]","Article body [kb_knowledge]"],"value":["kb_knowledge.number","kb_knowledge.short_description","kb_knowledge.text"],"description":"Fields to be returned"},{"name":"search_results_limit","value":"3","description":"Search results limit"},{"name":"semantic_index_names","label":["body","title"],"value":["body","title"],"description":"Semantic indexed fields"},{"name":"document_match_threshold","value":"00.72","description":"Document matching threshold"},{"name":"chunking_mode","value":"SMALL_TO_BIG"},{"name":"chunk_unit","value":"WORDS"},{"name":"chunk_size","value":"750"},{"name":"expanded_snippet_size","value":"750"}]
sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.name: Find Food Knowledge
sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.transformation_instructions:
Return only relevant Knowledge article information as source data for the AI Agent.
For each relevant article, return only: - Number - Short description - Article body
Select only articles relevant to the current Food Base Problem.
Prioritize articles that match the: - Use Case - Problem Type - Meal Type - Mess Hall - Description
Do not return: - Resolution Steps - Sources - URLs - citations - unrelated articles - recommendations - additional explanations
Do not determine or modify Priority from Knowledge articles.
Do not generate recommended_action in this tool. The AI Agent must use the relevant Knowledge information together with the Food Base Problem details to generate the final recommended_action.
